question: In what primordial cosmic setting is the Supreme Bhairava introduced as the speaker or agent?
premises: The verse refers to a former time.
It describes a terrible single ocean.
The Supreme Bhairava is named in that setting.
inference: The narrative situates the Supreme Bhairava in the primordial era of the terrible single ocean.
uncertainties: ghore may qualify ekārṇave or kāle; both readings are possible
plain_english: And formerly, at the terrible time of the single ocean, there was the Supreme Bhairava.
